items.headline: Treasurer & Chair, Finance, Audit & Risk Committee (Non-Executive Director) — Australasian Menopause Society (national / interstate)
items.summary: AMS is recruiting an experienced finance and governance professional to join its board as Treasurer and Chair of its Finance, Audit & Risk Committee, overseeing financial stewardship, reporting and risk for the peak health body.
items.so_what: An almost tailor-made match for your FCPA/FAICD profile — the Treasurer plus Chair-of-FARC remit is exactly your finance-and-governance sweet spot; board cadence makes the national/interstate footprint workable, so register your interest promptly.
